contracts.selection: The writer copies the input matrix to its stack, transforms each normal with its upper3x3, and evaluates an x87 wide dot against direction. It accepts ordered dot<=0 and also unordered comparisons. Four authored Dwarf Spider Droid normals contain quietNaNs; the native test accepts these faces. The portable writer preserves that branch, with96 additional single-component quietNaN probes; arbitrary infinite/signalingNaN inputs remain excluded.
contracts.metadata: An accepted face records the current vertex count and its edge count only when unsigned GroupCount<250, then increments GroupCount. A full table stops only metadata recording: vertex extrusion continues. Zero-edge accepted faces can still add a metadata entry. Vertex and generated counts persist across calls.
contracts.geometry: For each accepted edge, transform current and next vertex, wrapping to this polygon's first vertex at the last edge. Add direction directly to both points and emit four16-byte records in order[current,current+direction,next+direction,next], each with color0xffffffff. VertexCount increases4 and GeneratedValue increases6 per edge. This writer does not multiply direction by5, unlike adjacent ellipse/cylinder code; no cap vertices are emitted.
contracts.transforms: 5c03e0 forms four row-vector matrix products with original64-significand intermediate rounding, then stores four floats.5c0490 transformsXYZ using only the upper3x3 and copiesW. Separate exact-zero sign tracking preserves signed zero and subnormal results; native in-place vector cases match the owned-output portable projection.
